name: Pettenderly
tagline: Turn pet photos into portraits worth keeping.
short: Pettenderly turns photos of your cat or dog into downloadable AI pet portraits in watercolor, royal, studio and window-seat styles.
description: Create downloadable AI pet portraits from one to five photos of your cat or dog. Choose watercolor, royal, studio or window-seat styles. Paid credits start at $4.99 for 12; failed generations do not use credits. Generated details can vary.
introduce: Pettenderly is an AI pet portrait studio for cat and dog owners. Upload one to five clear photos of the same pet, choose a style, and create a digital portrait to download. Styles include watercolor, royal portraits, studio scenes and sunny window-seat settings. The service uses paid credits, with no credit charged for failed generations. Generated faces, markings and details can vary.
features: One to five reference photos; cat and dog portraits; multiple portrait styles; digital image downloads; credit-based generation.
checkpoint: Site submitted successfully; every submission reviewed before publication and acceptance not guaranteed.
